crossRefs.note: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the…
There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that…
But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and…
Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.
But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband
But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let…
But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.
I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of…
For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak…
Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully…
I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service;

translations.web: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.
translations.bsb: Now about virgins, I have no command from the Lord, but I give a judgment as one who by the Lord’s mercy is trustworthy.
translations.kjv: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.
translations.asv: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: but I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be trustworthy.
